name: client-app
description: An app to merge the gap between ADGA, your farm, and the internet.

scripts.build:renderer: (rm -r dist/renderer || rmdir dist/renderer) ; ng build renderer
scripts.package: (rm -r out || rmdir out) ; run-p build:* && electron-forge package
scripts.make: (rm -r out || rmdir out) ; run-p build:* && electron-forge make
scripts.publish:mac: run-p build:* && run-p sourcemap:* && electron-forge publish
scripts.publish:windows: run-p build:windows:* && run-p sourcemap:windows:* && electron-forge publish
scripts.rebuild:
tsc -m commonjs --esModuleInterop forge.config.ts && (echo '//GENERATED CODE, RUN `yarn rebuild` TO UPDATE
' && cat forge.config.js) > forge.config.js.tmp && mv forge.config.js.tmp forge.config.js
scripts.sourcemap:main: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject ./dist/main && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload ./dist/main --release "DigiGoat@$npm_package_version" --dist $SENTRY_DIST
scripts.sourcemap:renderer: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject ./dist/renderer/browser && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload ./dist/renderer/browser --release "DigiGoat@$npm_package_version" --dist $SENTRY_DIST
scripts.sourcemap:preload: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject ./dist/preload && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload ./dist/preload --release "DigiGoat@$npm_package_version" --dist $SENTRY_DIST
scripts.sourcemap:windows:main: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject ./dist/main && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload ./dist/main --release "DigiGoat@%npm_package_version%" --dist %SENTRY_DIST%
scripts.sourcemap:windows:renderer: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject ./dist/renderer/browser && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload ./dist/renderer/browser --release "DigiGoat@%npm_package_version%" --dist %SENTRY_DIST%
scripts.sourcemap:windows:preload: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject ./dist/preload && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload ./dist/preload --release "DigiGoat@%npm_package_version%" --dist %SENTRY_DIST%
